findings.title: Plugin request log loses traceID
findings.body: The old logRequest explicitly added a traceID (via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) to the log params, and that code was removed. The new code relies on m.logger.FromContext(ctx). That only adds traceID if the infra logger's context hooks inject it, and the diff does not show that they do. If they don't, the 'Plugin Request Completed' logs silently lose their trace correlation. The PR does not mention or test this change.

findings.title: Stale function name and no tests for the new middleware
findings.body: The helper is still called instrumentContext even though it now lives in the contextual logger middleware, which the rename was meant to clean up. The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no tests, and the moved behavior (logger attributes added to the context, and logging order relative to the other middlewares) is not covered anywhere.

findings.title: FromContext fallback drops context attributes
findings.body: If the type assertion fails, the code returns d.New(), which silently discards the context-derived attributes. The failure is not logged, so the logger has no endpoint or plugin fields and the loss is invisible.
